originalTitle: When will we see Robert Pattinson as Bond in cinemas?
summary: Robert Pattinson has been announced as the next James Bond, becoming the seventh actor to take up the mantle of 007.
content:
Robert Pattinson has been announced as the next James Bond, becoming the seventh actor and first in more than 20 years to take up the mantle of Britain's famous spy.

The new Bond film is expected to go into production in 2027, before its reported release in 2028. No exact dates have been announced.

It will be directed by Denis Villeneuve, known for Prisoners, Arrival and the upcoming Dune 3, which also stars Pattinson.

The BBC's culture correspondent Noor Nanji has this report.

chineseTitle: 我们什么时候才能在电影院看到罗伯特·帕丁森饰演邦德？
chineseSummary: 罗伯特·帕丁森被宣布为下一任詹姆斯·邦德，成为第七位接过 007 衣钵的演员。
chineseContent:
罗伯特·帕丁森被宣布为下一任詹姆斯·邦德，成为第七位演员，也是 20 多年来第一位接过英国著名间谍衣钵的演员。

新的邦德电影预计将于 2027 年投入制作，据报道将于 2028 年上映。具体日期尚未公布。

该片将由丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导，他因《囚徒》、《降临》和即将上映的《沙丘 3》而闻名，帕丁森也主演了该片。

BBC 文化记者 Noor Nanji 有此报道。

到目前为止我们对下一部 007 电影的了解
